summary.text: NINI BEACH AS is a private limited company registered in Fredrikstad, founded 2015-03-12. Its registered activity: "Restaurant og nattklubb." Its main industry code is 56.110 (drift av restauranter). The register shows 35 employees and 2 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 8 274 645 NOK and the annual result was -1 258 873 NOK; operating income was down from 8 287 153 NOK in 2024. Its verified website is ninibeach.com, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, TikTok profiles. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 35 on 2026-10-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-03-26.
